ios.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Vesper reads workouts, steps and sleep to mark your verified habits on their own. The readings stay on your phone; the days met only leave encrypted in your backup, or to your circle when they belong to a challenge.
ios.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Vesper does not write health data.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Vesper uses the camera only when you choose to add a photo to a day of a challenge.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Vesper only uses the photo you choose for a day of a challenge.
